manufacturer_geometry.datum: Carrier U2 footprint local mm: X=STEP Y+0.11; Y=STEP X+0.632; Z=STEP Z. The point(0,0) is a footprint datum, not PCB center.
manufacturer_geometry.height_basis: Vendor STEP without user-soldered headers. Physical header seating and cable strain relief must still be measured on the supplied boards.
manufacturer_geometry.verification_method: Nominal bounds verified from the pinned STEP BRep using CadQuery 2.8.0 / Open CASCADE 7.9; 1089 imported solids. Header centers, ANT1 datum and coordinate transform cross-checked against STEP entities and the manufacturer pinout.

thread_radio_nominal_fit.status: Nominal PCB and RF connector XY checked against manufacturer STEP; header seating, mated plug and formed bends require physical fit.

checks.verification_scope: Conservative digital envelopes and generated plastic only. Does not establish header orientation, material RF loss, purchased-part fit, thermal bias or RF coverage.
